async function keepAuthenticatedSessionAlive(){
 if(!runtime.ready||runtime.loading||!runtime.loaded||!runtime.authToken||!runtime.user||document.hidden||navigator.onLine===false)return false;

  runtime.lastSessionKeepAliveAt=Date.now();

  runtime.lastSessionKeepAliveStatus=String(error&&error.code||error&&error.message||'error');

  return false;
 }finally{
  runtime.keepAliveBusy=false;
 }
